nom: Philosophy Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in a dry winter climate, describe the balm as leaving skin soft and hydrated rather than stripped, though one still needed to add a moisturizer afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it rinses off silky and buttery-soft without feeling greasy or overly dry.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one prone to facial redness, report no irritation or breakouts from this balm.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with dry skin, describe the balm as leaving skin hydrated and never stripped or tight, though one reviewer in a dry winter climate still needed to follow up with a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive eyes or redness-prone cheeks, report no stinging or irritation, though a couple mention their eyes felt irritated afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts, and some note fewer breakouts with continued use, though one reviewer said it caused breakouts after a single use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it rinses clean without a greasy film, though a couple describe it as leaving an oily residue or feeling greasier than other balms they have used.

aspects.libelle: Thick texture takes effort to warm and spread
Doesn't fully remove waterproof mascara alone
Melts into a silky oil that rinses clean
A little product goes a long way
Jar packaging not travel-friendly, no spatula included

extraits.texte: This might be the worst cleansing balm I've ever tried. It was like rubbing lotion onto my face. It didn't melt down any makeup in my face. It caused breakouts after using it one time (the only thing that changed in my routine) . Its one redeeming quality might be that it didn't have a weird scent.

I was eager to try this because I love the regular purity cleanser. This might do an okay job cleansing your face, but a "balm" it is not. It is like rubbing cold cream onto your face. It is bot smooth and easy to spread around like a typical cleansing balm. It is thick and takes effort to move aroubd the face. Its fine when you add water and it rinses clean (with a TON of water) and it is boy irritating to the eyes. But if you are expecting an actual balm cleanser, stay away!

It's a nice texture on the skin, and it does melt makeup nicely but I feel like it leaves a film on my skin after rinsing and it has a very strong scent. For me, those two things are dealbreakers. I think if you like scented products, you might like this. And also if you like a good double cleanse, then this could work for you!

This was recommended to me by one of the employees because I've been battling dry skin. This removes makeup so easily including mascara and your face will feel incredibly soft and hydrated afterwards. It does not have that typical cleansing balm feel of feeling greasy. Its like a rich cream. It easily has become a new fave.

I am a huge fan of Philosphy , so I was excited to try the one step meltaway cleansing balm . First impression, loved the sunny yellow jar , the texture was silky to the touch . I scooped a finger full and applied to my face dry ( you can add water to face first before applying also ) I chose to use on dry skin ,because I wanted to remove my stubborn mascara first then massage some more into other areas . I quickly learned a little goes a long way , if you add water to it . I think I used too much my first trial , because it took a couple rinses to remove . I adjusted the amount next try and it was effortless to rinse . After rinse , my combo skin felt silky , buttery soft , I was astounded by the softness not only of my skin , but my lashes were so clean , soft and no trace of residual mascara . This totally lives up to its name as an amazing cleansing balm "made simple "

I have combination skin and this didn't make me feel greasy afterwards or super dry it removed my waterproof mascara and definitely left my skin feeling clean and smooth it has no scent and even if it did I wouldn't mind it absorbed enough to remove the makeup not enough to make me feel heavy or as if I had put something too oily

This stuff is amazing Helps melt away your makeup without harsh rubbing. Just a small amount goes a long way. Does not have an odor. Can be used for someone with sensitive skin, I have bad redness on my cheeks and did not think it caused increased redness. Would definitely recommend
